body: Six years ago today, Travis Scott @travisscott took over McDonald’s with the release of the Cactus Jack Meal 🍔🍟 The $6 order included a Quarter Pounder with cheese, bacon and lettuce, medium fries with BBQ sauce and a Sprite, Travis’ personal McDonald’s order. The collaboration marked the first time McDonald’s had placed a celebrity’s name on its menu since Michael Jordan in 1992. Demand became so high that some locations temporarily ran low on key ingredients, while fans flooded drive-thrus saying, “Cactus Jack sent me” 😭 Did you ever try the Travis Scott Meal? 👀
